name: GET /api/leadflow/contacts/:id/overview - the six panels
description:
CONTACTABILITY IS COMPUTED FROM LIVE COMPONENTS, never stored. A cached score outlives the consent that produced it — somebody withdraws consent on Tuesday and the score still says "highly reachable" on Friday, which is exactly when it gets acted on.

EVERY COMPONENT CARRIES A REASON. A component with no reason cannot be argued with, and an operator staring at "not eligible" with no sentence has nothing to act on and no way to tell whether it is wrong.

The channel vocabulary is the decision engine's own (call, not voice), used verbatim rather than translated, so a verdict cannot be requested for a channel the engine has no rules about and come back silently permissive.

Carries upstream_available and field_gaps like every read in this workspace: a panel that renders blank when an SDK is down is indistinguishable from one rendering a person who genuinely has no history. QA: measured live against a real contact from the list.

testCases.name: The overview panel returns its data with the reachability of each upstream
NEGATIVE: no contact with that id
NEGATIVE: no Authorization header at all
NEGATIVE: a bearer token that does not verify

errorCases.when: the contact id does not exist.

errorCases.message: Authorization header with a bearer token is required
errorCases.when: the Authorization header is absent, empty, or uses a scheme other than Bearer.

errorCases.message: Session token is invalid or expired
errorCases.when: a Bearer token was presented but does not verify.
